title: Adding to your order
blurb: Tambah satu lagi — calling the kakak back for more.

notes.title: tambah and lagi
notes.body: Tambah is “add”; satu lagi is “one more”. Together they cover almost any top-up: tambah roti satu lagi.

notes.title: tadi
notes.body: Tadi points back to earlier today: teh tarik tadi = the teh tarik from before. Staff use it to check which order you mean.

notes.title: … kan?
notes.body: kan? on the end asks for confirmation, like “right?”: kurang manis kan?

p1.en: Can I add to my order?
p1.note: Kak (kakak) is how you call a woman a bit older than you; Bang for a man.

p2.en: What do you want to add?

p4.note: yang ni = this one; biasa = normal, no tweaks.

p6.en: Can I get a bit more curry gravy?

p7.en: I'll bring it in a bit.

p9.ms: Dah habis lah, tinggal dada dengan kepak je.
p9.en: It's finished; only breast and wing are left.

p11.note: dah … belum? = already … or not yet?

p12.en: Too late to change it now.
p12.note: tak sempat = didn't make it in time.

dialogue.ms: Kak, nak tambah.
dialogue.en: I'd like to add something.

dialogue.ms: Nak tambah apa?
dialogue.en: What do you want to add?

dialogue.ms: Roti canai satu lagi.
dialogue.en: One more roti canai.

dialogue.ms: Air?
dialogue.en: Drinks?

dialogue.ms: Teh tarik satu lagi.
dialogue.en: One more teh tarik.

dialogue.ms: Okay, kejap ye.
dialogue.en: Okay, just a moment.

gist.q: What does he add to his order?
options: One more roti canai and one more teh tarik
Two more roti canai and no drink
gist.why: Roti canai satu lagi … teh tarik satu lagi.

options: What do you want to add?
What do you want to drink?

exercises.why: She's asking what to add; name the item + “satu lagi”.

dialogue.ms: Kak, nak tambah order boleh?
dialogue.en: Can I add to my order?

dialogue.ms: Boleh. Nak tambah apa?
dialogue.en: Sure. What do you want to add?

dialogue.ms: Roti telur satu lagi. Dengan teh tarik satu lagi.
dialogue.en: One more roti telur. And one more teh tarik.

dialogue.ms: Teh tarik tadi kurang manis kan? Yang ni pun sama?
dialogue.en: The teh tarik earlier was less sweet, right? Same for this one?

dialogue.ms: Yang ni biasa je. Untuk kawan saya.
dialogue.en: This one's just regular. It's for my friend.

dialogue.ms: Okay. Roti telur satu, teh tarik biasa satu. Ada apa-apa lagi?
dialogue.en: Okay. One roti telur, one regular teh tarik. Anything else?

dialogue.ms: Kuah kari boleh tambah sikit?
dialogue.en: Can I get a bit more curry gravy?

dialogue.ms: Boleh, nanti saya bawak.
dialogue.en: Sure, I'll bring it in a bit.

gist.q: How should the second teh tarik be made?
options: Less sweet, like the first one
gist.why: Yang ni biasa je. Untuk kawan saya.

options: The earlier teh tarik was less sweet, right? Same for this one?
The earlier teh tarik was too sweet, right? Want a new one?
The teh tarik is finished. Want something else?
Sure, I'll bring it in a bit.
Sure, take it from the counter.

exercises.prompt: Teh tarik tadi kurang manis kan? Yang ni pun sama?
exercises.why: She asks if the new one should match; “biasa je” says make it the normal way.

dialogue.ms: Kak, sorry, nak tambah order sikit.
dialogue.en: Sorry, I'd like to add a bit to my order.

dialogue.ms: Ha, boleh. Meja ni kan? Tadi dah order roti telur dengan teh tarik.
dialogue.en: Yeah, sure. This table, right? You ordered roti telur and teh tarik earlier.

dialogue.ms: Betul. Kawan saya baru sampai, so nak tambah untuk dia.
dialogue.en: Right. My friend just arrived, so I want to add something for him.

dialogue.ms: Okay, dia nak makan apa?
dialogue.en: Okay, what does he want to eat?

dialogue.ms: Dia nak nasi lemak ayam, tapi ayam tu nak bahagian peha kalau ada.
dialogue.en: He wants nasi lemak with chicken, but the thigh piece if you have it.

dialogue.ms: Peha dah habis lah, tinggal dada dengan kepak je.
dialogue.en: Thigh's finished; only breast and wing are left.

dialogue.ms: Kejap ye, saya tanya dia. Okay, dia cakap kepak pun boleh.
dialogue.en: One sec, I'll ask him. Okay, he says wing is fine too.

dialogue.ms: Okay, nasi lemak ayam, kepak. Air?
dialogue.en: Okay, nasi lemak with chicken, wing. Drinks?

dialogue.ms: Milo ais satu, kurang manis. Eh, roti telur saya tadi dah buat belum? Kalau belum, tukar jadi roti bawang boleh?
dialogue.en: One iced Milo, less sweet. Oh, has my roti telur been made yet? If not, can you change it to roti bawang?

dialogue.ms: Rasanya dah atas kuali tu. Tak sempat tukar dah.
dialogue.en: I think it's already on the pan. Too late to change it now.

dialogue.ms: Takpe lah, takpe. Tambah yang tadi je.
dialogue.en: Never mind, that's fine. Just add what I said.

dialogue.ms: Okay, nanti saya hantar sekali.
dialogue.en: Okay, I'll bring it all together.

gist.q: Why couldn't he change his roti telur to roti bawang?
options: It was already cooking on the pan
His friend wanted the roti telur
gist.why: Rasanya dah atas kuali tu. Tak sempat tukar dah.

options: Thigh is finished; only breast and wing are left.
Thigh and wing are finished; only breast is left.
There's plenty of thigh, but no wing.
I think it's already on the pan — too late to change.
I think it hasn't been started — I'll change it.
The pan is broken — it'll take a while.
I'll check with the kitchen and change it.

exercises.prompt: Rasanya dah atas kuali tu. Tak sempat tukar dah.
exercises.why: Nothing to be done; “Takpe lah” lets it go gracefully.
